title: Host credentials
description: Credentials your hosts use to connect to this server: host tokens you create here and device credentials created by wssp host enroll.

empty.title: No active host tokens
empty.description: Create a host token to connect a host without a device login.

tokens.title: Host tokens
tokens.description: Long-lived tokens for one host, set in the WSSP_HOST_TOKEN environment variable on that machine.

devices.title: Device credentials
devices.description: Created when you approve a wssp host enroll request. Each host keeps only its latest one.
devices.emptyDescription: Run wssp host enroll on a machine and approve it to create one.
devices.name: Device login for {{slug}}

mint.title: Create a host token
mint.description: The token lets one host connect as itself. It cannot call the SDK API or sign in to this dashboard.
mint.noHosts: You have no host that can take a token yet.
mint.connectHint: On the host, set WSSP_HOST_TOKEN to this token, then run:
mint.vmCapacityHint: wssp host run detects RAM, total vCPU (threads × 2) and a per-VM CPU cap. Override independently with --sandbox-memory-mib, --sandbox-vcpu-budget and --max-sandbox-cpu-count. Storage is configured in local TOML; reconnect after changes. Each works alone; supply all three if all detection fails.

revoke.tokenDescription: The host using this token is disconnected now and cannot reconnect with it. Running sandboxes are not stopped.
revoke.deviceDescription: The host is disconnected now and must run wssp host enroll again to reconnect. Running sandboxes are not stopped.
